pending_commit.commit_message: cryptohome: decouple cryptolib functions for SecureBlob/Blob Modify cryptolib to decouple Blobs and SecureBlobs under the rule that the hashing functions retain the base data type: instead of overloading the same function, create a separate function for Blob --> SecureBlob. This is in preparation for breaking the dependence between SecureBlob and Blob. This breaks function calls that implicitly convert into SecureBlob, therefore move the existing call functions into either SecureBlobs or use Sha*ToSecureBlob if the data is not moved/copied into another type. Move all Aes* functions to use SecureBlob for both ciphertext and plaintext: since most usages of Aes[En|De]crypt use SecureBlobs for both, this helps in decoupling mixed usage. Ideally, the ciphertext, once encrypted, should be a Blob: we revisit this once the dependence between SecureBlob and Blob is broken. BUG=chromium:728047 TEST=unittests pass. Change-Id: Iddd2bf6488c45f7e58fa607f2518b07ac09fd612 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1341221 Commit-Ready: Sarthak Kukreti <sarthakkukreti@chromium.org> Tested-by: Sarthak Kukreti <sarthakkukreti@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Gwendal Grignou <gwendal@chromium.org>

sarien: Add wilco_ec USE flag for custom kernel config To build kernel support for the Wilco Embedded Controller, we need some kernel configs set. However, we can't add them to the common .configs within the kernel, since doing so would break some other chromebooks. We need the configs set just for Wilco. Specifically, CONFIG_WILCO_EC depends upon CONFIG_CROS_EC_LPC_MEC, but we can't enable CONFIG_CROS_EC_LPC_MEC for all boards, since that would break all boards that don't use the Microchip EC. So for only Wilco we need to enable CONFIG_CROS_EC_LPC_MEC and all the desired CONFIG_WILCO_* configs. A solution to this has already been similarly implemented for other boards, so that each board gets a custom config. Specifically, in src/overlays/baseboard-glados/profiles/base/make.defaults the cros_ec_mec USE flag is set. Then, in src/third_party/chromiumos-overlay/eclass/cros-kernel2.eclass, some kernel configs are modified when that use flag is set. This commit enables the wilco_ec USE flag, that will get picked up by the eclass, which will turn on the proper kernel configs. BUG=b:124470322 TEST=manual: After applying CL:1474254 as well, the kernel builds with the wilco modules Change-Id: I1e3dbc001e164a30754abfac00674031a3d2da42 Signed-off-by: Nick Crews <ncrews@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1474707 Reviewed-by: Duncan Laurie <dlaurie@google.com>
